messages:
Sam Nguyen: Hey team — quick pre-release check for the 12:30 PT rollout. Ping owners for rollback readiness. Deploy steps are in /runbooks/release-2026.md. Can everyone confirm they can execute rollback within 5m if needed? :eyes:
Jordan Patel: I'm around for the window. Quick question: what's our primary rollback trigger? Latency >500ms or 3% 5xx?
Sam Nguyen: Primary triggers: >500ms p50 across frontend route for 5m, or >2% 5xx on model calls for 3m. Also any data-corruption alerts. See runbook excerpt:
Sam Nguyen: ```
# rollback quick
1) disable routing for model-prod in traffic-router
2) pin api to model-prod:v1.9
3) flush caches: /infra/scripts/flush_kv.sh
4) monitor: datadog-dashboard/release-crit
```
Mia Chen: I can run step 1-3. Leo, can you handle the traffic-router change + monitor checks?
Leo Park: Yep. I'll be oncall during the window. I have the traffic-router creds and the command: `curl -X POST https://router.internal/route/disable -d '{"model":"model-prod"}'`
Tara (oncall): Confirming pager escalation: if rollback triggered and not mitigated in 10m, page infra on call.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Sam Nguyen for 2026-03-17 19:30 UTC into prod-dedicated.
Jordan Patel: Smoke checklist real quick: 1) healthcheck /health 2) sample generate 3) embeddings sanity 4) latency tests — all good?
Mia Chen: I'll run smoke 1+2 once the canary is live, ETA 3m after deploy. Jordan will run latency tests.
Jordan Patel: Will do. If smoke fails, we hit rollback.
Sam Nguyen: Final call — go/no-go? Reply with :+1: to proceed, :no_entry_sign: to abort, or :hand: if delayed.
Leo Park: :+1:
Mia Chen: :+1:
Jordan Patel: :+1:
Tara (oncall): :+1: I'll standby for escalation.
Sam Nguyen: Thanks — proceeding with rollout at T+0. I'll post updates here. Also note the escape hatch timeline: rollback must complete within 15m to avoid capacity thrash.
Sam Nguyen: If anyone loses access, call me directly at +1-555-0102.
Jordan Patel: Copy. I'll ping here with smoke results.
Mia Chen: Smoke done — sample generation ok, 200/200 for quick prompts.
Jordan Patel: Latency p50 210ms, p95 480ms — under thresholds.
Leo Park: Traffic-router toggled to canary for 10% traffic, metrics look stable.
Sam Nguyen: Canary looks healthy at 10% for 7m. Proceeding to 50% in 2m.
Mia Chen: 50% rollout in progress.
Leo Park: 50% stable at 5m. No increase in errors.
Sam Nguyen: Full rollout starting. Keep watch and report any anomalies.
Jordan Patel: Seeing a small uptick in 5xx (0.7%). Under threshold.
Mia Chen: Still good.
Tara (oncall): All set. No pages.
Sam Nguyen: Full rollout complete. Closing thread; please update the runbook with any postmortem if rollback occurred. :party:
